awards.title: Attack Launcher
awards.definition: Highest positive average BLCxG with at least three evaluated offensive entries. BLCxG sums own-team shot xG until the puck leaves the offensive zone or play stops, including shots after a puck recovery. Ties favor more evaluated entries, then player ID.

awards.title: Escape Artist
awards.definition: Most controlled defensive zone exits with the exported outcome PossessionMaintained. Ties favor the higher controlled-exit share, then player ID. Possession is assessed at the crossing, without a later retention window.

awards.title: Puck Hunter
awards.definition: Most puck battles won (Wisehockey PCW) across all zones, requiring a positive count. Ties favor more interceptions, then the lexicographically greatest player ID. Interceptions and blocked shots are supporting context, not a weighted score.

awards.title: Pass Thief
awards.definition: Most intercepted opponent passes across all zones, requiring a positive count. PassResult=Intercepted credits the opposing secondary skater. Ties favor more puck battles won (PCW), then the lexicographically greatest player ID.
